original_case.purpose: queue saturation: offered rate exceeds sagged capacity on five_g; exercises buffer fill, overflow drops and queue-delay ceiling

records.calibration_role: existing switch-effect model input, not independent validation evidence
records.emulator_endpoints: step 0 to first post-load step with summed residual below one packet, or scaled 3*max_buffer/min_service bound
records.runner_endpoint_status: opt-in --matched-drain: common anchored inspection-grid definition, actual host sampling times and lateness reported; no denominator equality assumed
records.case_interpretation: sustained sag from event to end is a working interpretation, not recovered original intent

queue_delay_ms.reason: no per-packet queue delay on either engine: emulator has an aggregate occupancy/service drain estimate (env/sdwan_env.py:243-249); the Mininet residence-minus-base candidate (analysis/candidates/queue_delay_proxy.py) is UNVALIDATED (smoke: 28.0% negatives, reasons hypothesized, not established). Never emitted as an accepted queue_delay_ms.

run_manifest.label: raw_unvalidated_scaffolding
run_manifest.case_interpretation: sustained sag from event to end is a working interpretation, not recovered original intent

capacity_convention.basis: P1 diagnostic 18 Nov 2026 (docs/cross_engine_p1_rate_diagnostic_results.md): qdisc counters 1442 B/pkt exact; service-slope and backlog-slope agreement with wire-length token accounting (exploratory, post-observation discriminators); no universal claim

limitations: constant-series mode carries zero trace jitter; case jitter_ms has no emulator-side expression in this mode
emulator delay/jitter are per-step aggregates, not per-packet statistics; no estimator-level mapping is claimed
interruption_s is the calibrated switching-model effect; the validation plan expects a mismatch against the testbed (informative, kept out of the comparator CSV in emulator_informative.csv)
capacity events mutate the input series from the event step, mirroring the testbed tc rate change at the event point
numeric rows cover natively expressible metrics only, over the full-run window matching testbed/analyze.py (no warmup exclusion); coverage.json is the fail-closed record for everything else
delay units: testbed netem delay is one-way on a single link; constant_series rtt_ms = 2 * one_way_delay_ms so that the emulator 0.5 RTT factor reproduces the configured one-way delay
queue convention: testbed limit is netem/TBF max_queue_size in packets; matched buffer bytes = limit_packets * packet_bytes

capacity convention: matched capacities are scaled by packet_bytes/1442 (working convention for this setup, P1 exploratory evidence; see run_manifest.capacity_convention); nominal case values are in the scenario JSON

loss_frac comparability needs constant datagram size, an aligned full-run window, and boundary handling: bytes still queued at episode end are counted as neither delivered nor dropped here, so end_residual_occupancy_bytes is reported per run as the boundary term

delay/jitter estimator rows (emulator_estimator.csv) are per-step aggregate candidates, quality estimator_candidate_unvalidated; never comparator gate evidence; coverage.json keeps both metrics unsupported

drain phase is opt-in (--drain) until the owner adopts the D2 endpoint definition: load stops at duration_s, the episode ends when every queue holds less than one packet (termination 'drained') or at the 3x buffer/service bound ('bound_hit'), and the actual measurement window is recorded per run
